text:
{
  "scorecard": [
    {
      "promise": "Full year FY26 guidance of 20% growth.",
      "made_in": "Nov 2025",
      "quote": "This year we have given a guidance of 20% growth for the full year and we are going to achieve it",
      "outcome": "FY26 (Mar 2026) annual revenue grew 12.64% to ₹6,569 Cr from ₹5,832 Cr in Mar 2025.",
      "verdict": "missed",
      "evidence_source": "Annual Financials Mar 2026"
    },
    {
      "promise": "Adhesive EBITDA margin steadily in 15% to 16% range continuously.",
      "made_in": "Nov 2025",
      "quote": "EBITDA margin is also very stable and moving in the range of 15% to 16% continuously. We are confident that this run rate will continue",
      "outcome": "In Aug 2026 call, Adhesive Business India EBITDA margin fell to 12.2% and UK EBITDA margin dropped to 4.9%.",
      "verdict": "missed",
      "evidence_source": "Aug 2026 call reported metrics"
    },
    {
      "promise": "Adhesive business growing steadily at 15% run rate.",
      "made_in": "Nov 2025",
      "quote": "adhesive business as usual, the business is steadily growing at 15% run rate and we are confident that it will keep growing at the same run rate",
      "outcome": "Nov 2025 report showed H1 Adhesive EBITDA margin at 15.6%, but Aug 2026 reported Adhesive UK growth at only 5% in Q2.",
      "verdict": "partly",
      "evidence_source": "Nov 2025 & Aug 2026 call reported metrics"
    },
    {
      "promise": "Double digit margin for UK business next year.",
      "made_in": "Nov 2025",
      "quote": "we said for the next year we are predicting that the double digit margin will be there",
      "outcome": "UK business EBITDA margin came in at 7.33% (Nov 2025 reported) and 4.9% (Aug 2026 reported).",
      "verdict": "missed",
      "evidence_source": "Nov 2025 & Aug 2026 call reported metrics"
    },
    {
      "promise": "Reach ₹1,000 crores in paints business in next 3 to 4 years.",
      "made_in": "May 2026",
      "quote": "targeting to reach 1,000 crores in next 3 to four years and even cross that",
      "outcome": "Horizon extends to FY29-FY30; H1 paint growth was reported at 19% in Nov 2025.",
      "verdict": "too_early",
      "evidence_source": "May 2026 guidance / Nov 2025 reported"
    },
    {
      "promise": "Double sale in fire pipes this year.",
      "made_in": "May 2026",
      "quote": "Last year we've doubled our sale in fire pipes and we are looking to double that sale this year as well.",
      "outcome": "Specific fire pipe sales volumes were not detailed in subsequent reports.",
      "verdict": "unverifiable",
      "evidence_source": "Aug 2026 call reported metrics"
    },
    {
      "promise": "Full year FY27 top line value growth over 20%.",
      "made_in": "Aug 2026",
      "quote": "our value growth for the full year will be more than 20%, in top line.",
      "outcome": "Jun 2026 YoY revenue grew 16.0% and Sep 2026 YoY revenue grew 26.0%. FY27 full year incomplete.",
      "verdict": "too_early",
      "evidence_source": "Quarterly Results Jun 2026 / Sep 2026"
    },
    {
      "promise": "Plumbing EBITDA margin in 16% to 18% range for FY27.",
      "made_in": "Aug 2026",
      "quote": "we will be definitely going to be in the range of 16% to 18%.",
      "outcome": "Aug 2026 report showed Plumbing EBITDA Margin achieved 18.9%.",
      "verdict": "delivered",
      "evidence_source": "Aug 2026 call reported metrics"
    }
  ],
  "credibility": {
    "delivered": 1,
    "partly": 1,
    "missed": 3,
    "summary": "Management tends to over-promise on overall revenue growth targets and adhesive segment margins, frequently missing full-year and subsidiary margin expectations."
  },
  "narrative_vs_numbers": [
    "Promised 20% full-year FY26 growth in Nov 2025, but actual Mar 2026 annual revenue grew only 12.64%.",
    "Guided 15-16% stable adhesive margins, but actual UK margins fell to 7.33% and 4.9%, and India adhesive margins fell to 12.2%.",
    "Promised 16-18% plumbing EBITDA margin in Aug 2026, which was delivered with an actual reported margin of 18.9%."
  ]
}
